name: – Georgios Aftias – Proposal for a decision
title: Mobilisation of the European Union Solidarity Fund: assistance to Italy, Slovenia, Austria, Greece and France relating to six natural disasters occurred in 2023
part_text:
The European Parliament approves giving money from the European Union Solidarity Fund to five countries hit by floods in 2023. Italy receives two payments, for Emilia-Romagna and Tuscany. Slovenia, Austria, Greece and France also receive money. In total, about 1.03 billion euro is released. The Parliament also calls for faster payouts, more money for the fund in the future, and better protection for islands and coastal areas, which it says are especially exposed to climate risks.

- About 1.03 billion euro goes to Italy, Slovenia, Austria, Greece and France for 2023 floods.
- People and regions in these five countries recover with this aid; payouts should come faster.
- Parliament leaders sign the decision with the Council, then it is published and applies.
